scenarios.title: Open representative testimonial book links from the success stories page
scenarios.intent: Prove the success stories page exposes working testimonial book links that lead from the social-proof page into showcased book detail pages on the platform.
scenarios.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to repeated testimonial links and used a covering array over testimonial_position classes {first, middle, last}. Risk-judged interaction strength was 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss applies; covering_array degraded to strength=1 because there was only one input, so the scenario sweeps first, middle, and last testimonials as representative link positions. Negative, boundary, security, a11y, perf, and i18n scenario families were judged not applicable from the current source because REQ-09 specifies only public content presence and link availability, with no alternate outcomes, role gates, limits, or localized variants.

scenarios.title: Review the success stories page heading, testimonial count, and testimonial fields
scenarios.intent: Prove the success stories page presents the promised heading, exactly six testimonials, and the required content on every testimonial card.
scenarios.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the repeated testimonial-card structure and retained one page-level content journey because every testimonial is expected to show the same field set. Count verification covers the fixed collection size named in REQ-09. Negative, boundary, edge, security, a11y, perf, and i18n scenario families were judged not applicable from the current source because the requirement states only the successful public display of static testimonial content and provides no failure behavior, limits, or alternate render modes.

judgements.rationale: Kept first because broken or misdirected testimonial links most directly damage the use-case's social-proof purpose by preventing visitors from validating an author's showcased book.
Kept second because the heading, testimonial count, and field presence are core content promises for every visitor, but they are less damaging than links that route to the wrong destination.
